demoNarrative: Open on Overview: one estate, 214 runs in 24h, 96% success, and three things needing attention right now — not a green wall of nothing.
Jobs: the boring critical path. EOD close, SWIFT ingestion, card settlement. Point out that EOD requires approval — a bank does not let anyone rerun the ledger close.
Executions: click the failed NEFT reconciliation. The break did not just alert, it started the repair workflow automatically.
Workflows: open Payment Exception Repair — 64% auto-repaired, the rest held at a payments-desk approval gate. Automation with a human where money moves.
AI Workflows: open AML Alert Disposition Assistant. The model drafts the narrative; the analyst still decides. Say that out loud — it is the question every bank compliance officer asks.
Agents: Ops Copilot can rerun allowlisted jobs but cannot post an entry or release a payment. Guardrails are the product, not a footnote.
Schedule: EOD chain pages the duty manager on overrun rather than continuing silently.
Close on Governance: compliance score, approval gates and an immutable audit trail behind everything just shown.
